King Edward VIII had quite a brief reign in 1936, lasting only from January 20th to December 11th when he abdicated to marry Wallis Simpson. During those approximately 11 months, Stanley Baldwin was the Prime Minister of the United Kingdom. Baldwin actually played a crucial role in the abdication crisis, as he informed Edward that the government would not support his marriage to Simpson while he remained king.

Answer: Stanley Baldwin
